companyDescription.title: Company Description
companyDescription.text:
Veza(part of ServiceNow now) is the pioneer in identity security, purpose-built to answer the fundamental question enterprises face: who can and should take what action on what data. Veza's Access Graph platform maps an organization's entire identity ecosystem  across users, groups, roles, policies, permissions, and resources  providing deep visibility and control over human, non-human, and agentic identities across SaaS, cloud, on-prem, and custom applications. With over 30 billion access permissions under management, global enterprises including Blackstone, Expedia, and Wynn Resorts trust Veza to manage privileged access monitoring, non-human identity security, access entitlement management, and next-generation identity governance.  

Founded in 2020 , Veza is now part of the ServiceNow family, with the acquisition closing in March 2026. The combination brings together Veza's AI-native Access Graph with ServiceNow's AI Control Tower and agentic workflows, enabling organizations to enforce end-to-end identity security rooted in the principle of least privilege across applications, data, cloud environments, and AI agents. For engineers joining Veza today, this means the scale and resources of an enterprise platform company, with the product velocity and mission-driven focus of a security innovator at a pivotal moment in the industry.

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
About the Team  

We are seeking a passionate, experienced Sr Software Engineering Manager to lead Veza's NHI and Agent Security team, which is redefining next-generation security at Veza. The team is advancing Agent Identity Security as AI agents and copilots rapidly expand across enterprise systems. The team drives innovation, defines next-generation IGA for non-human identities and agents, and helps shape new industry standards as the AI agent ecosystem evolves. Its work includes discovering agents, tracking their actions, and defining access management and runtime authorization capabilities to maintain a strong security posture.  

 

This is a high-impact leadership role at the center of the engineering organization. 

 

You will combine engineering leadership with deep technical partnership by leading skilled engineers and tech leads and setting the technical vision for NHI and Agent Security. You will work closely with product, integrations, and security engineering teams to expand Veza’s capabilities as the company scales within the ServiceNow ecosystem. 

Technical Leadership 

  • Own the technical vision and roadmap for Veza's NHI and Agent Security team - the core team that drives visibility, and governance of NHI and Agent Identities. 
  • Drive architecture, design patterns, and engineering best practices for building enterprise systems. 
  • Partner with the Tech leads and Senior Engineers on high-impact technical decisions, conducting design and code reviews to ensure quality and adherence to engineering standards. 
  • Identify and champion new technologies, tools, and approaches, including AI/ML, to continuously advance the product development. 
  • Ensure the product is built and maintained with high performance, reliability, and observability, including logging, monitoring, and compliance requirements. 
  • Define and drive detailed engineering execution plans, timelines, and processes that keep the team shipping with quality and predictability. 
  • Shape our long-term agent identity security roadmap alongside the Product team and help define industry standards for discovering agents, auditing actions taken on agents, securing runtime authorization, and ensuring least privilege access management. 

Cross-functional Collaboration 

  • Work closely with Product, Integrations, Platform, Graph and other product teams to achieve business objectives and build product that meets customer needs 
  • Partner with other ServiceNow teams to drive and unlock next-gen identity governance.  

People Leadership 

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of backend software engineers and tech leads, building individual development plans and creating stretch opportunities. 
  • Own the full talent lifecycle for the team - hiring, onboarding, retention, and performance.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Experience 

  • 10+ years of experience in backend software engineering with a strong focus on distributed systems, or identity security, and 4+ years in an engineering leadership role - ideally spanning both startup and enterprise SaaS environments. 
  • Experience integrating AI/ML models into product workflows, or leveraging AI to enhance product experience, or system intelligence at scale - strongly preferred. 
  • Familiarity with emerging AI technologies and frameworks, with a track record of driving AI adoption and leveraging AI-driven tools to enhance team productivity and engineering efficiency. 
  • Familiarity with IGA or how traditionals systems are evolving with Agents. 
  • Deep familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), distributed systems, and containerization technologies such as Kubernetes. 
  • Experience with authentication, authorization protocols, and IAM concepts — understanding how identity and access relationships are structured across complex enterprise environments. 
  • Hands-on engineering background with proficiency in one or more of Go, Java, or Python — comfortable diving into the codebase and engaging at a technical depth appropriate for a player-coach role. 

Leadership 

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and grow a fully distributed, high-performing engineering team - hiring, onboarding, mentoring, and retaining strong engineers and tech leads. 
  • Strong organizational and project management skills - able to run multiple workstreams, maintain engineering cadence, and keep delivery on track without micromanaging. 
  • Clear, proactive communicator who can translate complex technical concepts for both engineering teams and senior leadership. 

Who You Are 

  • Relentlessly high standards - never satisfied with the status quo, always looking for a better way. 
  • Able to dive deep without losing sight of the big picture - never out of touch with the technical details, never lost in them either. 
  • Low ego, high intellectual curiosity - you hire people smarter than you and create the conditions for them to do their best work. 

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $190,900 - $334,100, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Work Personas

We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity,  veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.  

Accommodations

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance. 

Export Control Regulations

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
